en_title: Nintendo Legend Shigeru Miyamoto Becomes First Game Designer to Be Awarded Japan's Order of Culture
cn_title: 宫本茂成首位获日本文化勋章的游戏设计师
subtitle: 游戏业的至高荣誉
opus_summary: 任天堂传奇设计师宫本茂将获日本文化勋章，成为首位获得该荣誉的游戏开发者。日本天皇将于11月3日文化日向他及另外七位获奖者颁授勋章。

paragraphs.en: Legendary Nintendo designer Shigeru Miyamoto will receive Japan’s highest honor for cultural merit next month. The 73-year old is the first video game developer to receive the Order of Culture, which is presented by the Emperor of Japan.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂传奇设计师宫本茂将于下月获得日本文化领域的最高荣誉。现年73岁的宫本茂是首位获得文化勋章的电子游戏开发者，该勋章由日本天皇授予。

paragraphs.en: “I feel incredibly awkward but truly honored to be selected for such a prestigious award,” Miyamoto told the press on October 23. “As I often point out, I don’t create games on my own. This award is the result of working together with a great number of people, so I will accept it on their behalf.”
paragraphs.cn: 宫本茂于10月23日对媒体表示：「获选如此 prestigous 的奖项让我感到非常不自在，但也确实深感荣幸。正如我经常指出的那样，游戏并非由我独自创作。这份荣誉来自众多人士的共同努力，因此我将代表他们接受这项荣誉。」

paragraphs.en: “Recently, I’ve been privileged to work with people from many different fields, not just games,” he added, referencing Super Nintendo World attractions at Universal Studios and films like The Super Mario Galaxy Movie. “I’d like to share the joy of this award with everyone.”
paragraphs.cn: 他还提到了环球影城的超级任天堂世界园区，以及《超级马力欧银河大电影》等影片，并补充道：「最近，我有幸与来自许多不同领域的人合作，而不只是游戏领域。我想和大家分享获得这份荣誉的喜悦。」

paragraphs.en: Miyamoto is currently Nintendo’s Executive Fellow and Representative Director. He joined the company in 1977, playing a pivotal and formative role in Nintendo’s move towards making video games. While most famous for creating the Mario series (with the iconic Nintendo mascot’s first appearance in 1981’s Donkey Kong), Miyamoto also played key roles in the development of other major Nintendo franchises including The Legend of Zelda and Star Fox.
paragraphs.cn: 宫本茂目前担任任天堂执行顾问兼代表董事。他于1977年加入任天堂，在公司转向电子游戏开发的过程中发挥了关键且奠基性的作用。宫本茂最为人熟知的成就是创作《超级马力欧》系列，该系列标志性任天堂吉祥人物最早于1981年的《大金刚》中登场。他还参与了任天堂其他重要系列的开发，包括《塞尔达传说》和《星际火狐》。

paragraphs.en: “50 years ago, I became involved in video games, a medium whose form was still very undefined, and I have been fortunate to continue in this line of work ever since.” Miyamoto said. “I feel like it’s precisely because I’ve been here since the dawn of the industry that I’m being honored in this way, and think I have been incredibly lucky in life.”
paragraphs.cn: 宫本茂说道：「50年前，我投身于电子游戏行业。当时，这种媒介的形式仍非常模糊，而我很幸运能够一直从事这份工作至今。我觉得，正是因为我从这个行业的黎明时期就参与其中，才会以这种方式获得荣誉；我也认为自己一生都非常幸运。」

paragraphs.en: Japan’s Order of Culture, as the name suggests, is awarded to individuals deemed to have made outstanding contributions to the development of culture. It covers a broad scope, from the sciences to literature and the arts. Previous well-known recipients include film director Akira Kurosawa, fashion designer Issey Miyake, and Godzilla composer Akira Ifukube.
paragraphs.cn: 日本文化勋章顾名思义，授予被认为对文化发展作出杰出贡献的人士。其涵盖范围十分广泛，从科学到文学与艺术领域均包括在内。此前的知名获奖者包括电影导演黑泽明、时装设计师三宅一生，以及《哥斯拉》作曲家伊福部昭。

paragraphs.en: The Emperor of Japan will present Miyamoto and the other seven recipients with their Order of Culture awards. Like in previous years, the ceremony will be held on November 3, Japan’s Culture Day national holiday.
paragraphs.cn: 日本天皇将向宫本茂及另外七位获奖者颁授文化勋章。和往年一样，授勋仪式将于11月3日、日本文化日这一全国性节假日举行。

paragraphs.en: Verity Townsend is a Japan-based freelance writer who previously served as editor, contributor and translator for the game news site Automaton West. She has also written about Japanese culture and movies for various publications.
paragraphs.cn: Verity Townsend是一名常驻日本的自由撰稿人，曾担任游戏新闻网站Automaton West的编辑、撰稿人和译者。她还曾为多家媒体撰写有关日本文化与电影的文章。
